'''August 1999 Newcastle tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG regional qualifier held in Newcastle, England on 22 August 1999. [[Alex Tennet]] won it. It is known from Alex Tennet's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d18">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/1999-08-24-newcastle-united-kingdom-8-22-99d18/ newcastle-united-kingdom-8-22-99], DeckTech (Alex "Greedo" Tennet, 24 August 1999). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/1999-08-24-newcastle-united-kingdom-8-22-99d18/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 22 August 1999
* '''Site:''' Newcastle, England
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Players:''' 13
* '''Winner:''' [[Alex Tennet]]
